column2: HEX player setup
Personal equipment setup
Yellow Turban 1
Die!
Archer 2
Curse you...
Yellow Turban 4
Ah!
Strategist 1
Ah...
Archer 1
Hah... I cannot hold on!
At this rate, we will be wiped out.
Infantry 1
Damn! More Yellow Turbans keep coming.
Cavalry reinforcements will arrive soon.
We must hold our ground!
Infantry 2
I would rather save my own life.
What imperial soldier thinks otherwise these days?
This is Yingchuan, the fiercest fighting of all.
The corrupt court will not send troops here to die.
Perhaps, but the cavalry commander is Cao Cao.
I hear he is a formidable man.
Let us put our faith in him this once.
All we can do now is wait.
Hurry... please hurry!
Imperial troop image
Zhang Bao
They are stubborn fighters.
Zhang Liang
Hmph! We will defeat them soon enough!
Those imperial dogs dare attack us here!
They will regret it.
Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang dialogue
Victory conditions
1. Defeat Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang.
Defeat conditions
1. Cao Cao dies.
2. The battle exceeds 20 turns.
Hold on a little longer!
Show them the imperial army is no easy prey!
Liu Bei
It seems we arrived in time.
But they are badly outnumbered.
The imperial troops are struggling.
Guan Yu
We should strike from both sides,
though our own force is rather small...
Zhang Fei
Brother, you worry too much!
I could handle them alone.
We cannot abandon the imperial troops.
Let us circle behind and strike their fort.
Charge!
Brothers, wait!
The troops ahead will be destroyed at this rate.
Let us set fires here.
Yes! Draw their attention this way.
It might even shake their resolve.
Then I will light the fires.
I do not want needless deaths on either side.
Be careful how far you let them spread.
Zhang Fei sets fires
Light this spot too!
Guan Yu sets fires
No, no! The flames are too small!
They will never reach the fort!
Heh, heh, heh!
Then how about this?
Huh?
Who is there!?
Fire starts
Recall Vermilion Bird
Yellow Turban 11
Fire! Fire!
Yellow Turban 10
The enemy is attacking from behind!
What? A surprise attack!?
Imperial reinforcements?
Send men to deal with the rear!
Damn... no one is listening!
Yellow Turbans become confused
What is going on!?
I do not know, but we cannot worry about that now.
We must deal with what is before us.
The enemy is in chaos.
This is our chance for victory!
Our targets are Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang.
Charge!
Liu Bei dialogue
Cao Cao
I heard the imperial troops here were in trouble.
But these flames...!?
Cavalry 1
Captain! Those men seem to have lit the fires.
They do not look like imperial soldiers.
Hmm. They appear to be volunteers.
Go to the fort. I will speak to them.
Yes, sir!
Cavalry 2
I am Cao Cao, courtesy name Mengde, captain of the imperial cavalry.
The court has sent me against the Yellow Turbans.
May I ask your name?
I am Liu Bei, courtesy name Xuande. Though born a humble farmer,
I could not stand by while the realm fell into chaos.
I raised volunteers to fight the rebels and protect the people.
Please allow my two brothers and me to aid your army.
We await your orders, Lord Cao.
Thanks to you, Liu Bei, the Yellow Turbans are already in disarray.
There is little need for orders from me.
We need only defeat the two men in the fort.
Fight as you see fit. Until we meet again.
Cao Cao's army arrives
Defeat Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang!
Tutorial
Still resisting, Zhang Bao?
The Han's time is over. The realm belongs to the Yellow Turbans now!
You should join us!
The Han may fall one day,
but you will not be the ones to succeed it.
Hmph!
You...! There is no need to die for the Han!
Your wicked sect has brought chaos to the land.
I will not stand aside. Prepare to die.
You must be Zhang Liang.
Rebel or not, you command an army.
Have the sense to surrender.
Enough talk! I will kill you first!
A rebel through and through.
You cannot even see the situation before you.
You are unfit to command. Hmph!
It is a shame for a man like you to remain a mere volunteer, Liu Bei.
Why not serve alongside me?
War still rages in many places.
Though I am grateful for your offer,
we must continue fighting the rebels.
I see. Then I will not press you.
I have other duties as well.
Farewell, until another day.
He is unlike the imperial officers I have met before.
Cao Cao, was it...?
These troubled times are unpredictable. We may meet again.
Let us deal with the remaining Yellow Turbans
and make our way to Gongsun Zan's camp.
We can decide our future once we arrive.
Fine by me, so long as there is food!
Hahahaha!
(Liu Xuande...
Will we next meet as friends or enemies?
Only Heaven knows.)
Good. That should quiet the Yellow Turbans here.
(Liu Xuande... a mere volunteer,
yet such a capable fighter. I must remember him.)
Check Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang deaths
Am I truly to die here? Ugh...
Curse them... defeated by the likes of these!
I wanted to halt the Yellow Turbans,
but I do not yet have the strength...
There is no point fighting on. Retreat.
Damn it! Zhang Fei, defeated?
There must be some mistake!
Ugh... where are the reinforcements...?
Cao Cao was defeated by the Yellow Turbans.
Sun Quan army weakening
Yuan Shao
We now attack Sishui Pass, held by Dong Zhuo.
Take it in one push, then march on Luoyang!
Xiahou Dun
Mengde, why give supreme command to Yuan Shao?
Leading the coalition would bring great renown!
This way, Yuan Shao will gladly fund the coalition.
We can focus on fighting well
and earn an even greater reputation.
So you leave the troublesome work to Yuan Shao?
You really are a clever one.
But if we fail to distinguish ourselves here,
it will all be for nothing.
I am counting on you, Yuanrang.
Leave it to me!
With Xiahou Dun here, our army cannot fail!
Hahaha!
Sun Jian
Have the supplies still not arrived?
Cheng Pu
No, my lord.
I hear the man in charge has stopped sending food.
So the enemy before us is not our only threat.
This alliance may not last much longer.
We must plan a way out.
Pre-battle dialogue
1. Defeat all enemies.
Defeat all enemies!
My lord, the soldiers cannot fight any longer.
We should retreat.
Do not lose your nerve!
The enemy is right before us.
One mistake could cost us our lives.
Huang Gai
My lord, I do not regret coming.
But we have not lost to the enemy...
we have lost to our own allies.
Sun Jian's army becomes confused
Li Su
What is this? Their vanguard is faltering.
This is our chance to win glory!
Li Su attacks
Li Jue
I knew today would be auspicious.
This battle is ours!
Li Jue arrives
Guo Si
They look half-starved. They are no match for us!
Defeating an army without food
will be child's play!
Guo Si arrives
My lord, the enemy has launched a surprise attack!
Stay calm and meet them!
Panic will only serve the enemy!
What? An ambush!?
Cao Cao, go to Sun Jian's aid at once!
If the vanguard is destroyed, our whole army's morale will suffer.
Coalition shaken
Damn! They have reached our main camp!
How infuriating!
If this place falls, Chancellor Dong Zhuo will have our heads!
Fight to the death!
Most of the enemy has been defeated...
But our losses are heavy too. Should we retreat?
Retreat
Keep fighting
General Yuan, the enemy is formidable.
Fighting on will only increase our losses.
Please order a withdrawal.
Hmm, yes. The whole army will retreat!
We have fought well enough.
Withdraw at once!
This is no time to retreat. Finish the remaining enemy
and show them the coalition's might!
I am Guan Yu, courtesy name Yunchang, Liu Bei's sworn brother.
I will face you.
Hua Xiong
Hmph! An unknown nobody!
I am Guan Yu, courtesy name Yunchang.
Hua Xiong, I have come for your head!
A mere volunteer dares speak so boldly?
You will regret it!
Come on!
Hmph! Come at me if you dare!
Curse you... aaagh!
Guan Yu has slain the enemy general Hua Xiong!
Duel resolution
Ah! General Hua Xiong has been defeated!
I am Hua Xiong! You rebels who oppose Chancellor Dong,
I will deal with you first!
If any man in the coalition does not fear death,
let him taste my steel! Hahaha!
That is Dong Zhuo's fierce general Hua Xiong!?
Who among us dares face him?
I am Guan Yu, serving under Liu Bei.
Please send me, my lord.
How could we send a mere volunteer?
The coalition's honor is at stake!
Stand down.
I cannot let that remark pass.
If we all seek to overthrow Dong Zhuo,
what does a man's rank or regiment matter?
General Guan, please calm yourself.
General Yuan, consider this:
if a volunteer defeats Hua Xiong,
the enemy's morale will collapse.
Would that not be all the better?
I see. There is sense in that.
Very well, General Guan. Forgive my words.
You shall duel Hua Xiong.
General Guan, let me offer you a cup of wine.
(Hmm. He manages to please both sides.
A remarkable man.
I shall indulge him.)
Thank you for the wine... gulp.
I will slay Hua Xiong before its warmth has faded.
Such courage and confidence!
(I must reach Hua Xiong first. Hyah!)
Why must Yuan Shao make enemies at every turn?
Command like this will harm the whole army.
He is not fit to lead this coalition...
Ah! I never thought the coalition was so strong,
or that we would fall so low!
Aaah...
Oh no!
I forgot today's omen warned against the name Cao!
Impossible! Were they not a disorganized mob?
Damn! We underestimated them!
Ugh... formidable indeed.
Now let the regular troops prove themselves.
I must withdraw!
Damn it. We will retreat for now.
Cao Cao, I leave the rearguard to you.
I await your good news at the main camp.
We have no choice. Retreat!
More fighting would only waste lives.
If not for that surprise attack...
No, our own allies are the worst of all!
What a pity!
Hmph! In a fair fight,
even Dong Zhuo might not beat us!
Excellent! The enemy is finally defeated!
Victory is ours!
We survived thanks to you, Cao Cao.
You have my deepest gratitude!
I wish to pursue the remnants from Sishui Pass.
Could you spare some provisions?
We have only just ended one battle,
and I never expected it to be so fierce...
Then I shall share our supplies with you.
You have my thanks!
Please accept this in return.
This is...!?
We take our leave. Let us meet at the main camp.
Cao Cao was defeated by Dong Zhuo's army.
Lu Bu
Lure the coalition deeper before attacking.
No one is to advance without my command.
Fan Chou
My lord, can General Lu manage alone?
Should we not fight as well?
Dong Zhuo
No man alive can defeat Fengxian.
Li Ru
My lord's foresight
commands my deepest admiration.
Zhang Ji
(Hmph. What a flatterer!)
Dong Zhuo army dialogue
Dong Zhuo is before us. For the sake of the people,
we must destroy him.
Brother, first we must defeat Lu Bu.
Leave him to me. I will cut him down in one stroke!
He is no easy opponent, brother.
But Lu Bu is indeed their leading general.
If we defeat him,
the coalition will have victory.
Understood. Let us concentrate on Lu Bu.
Hmph! I have been wanting to fight him.
Then we shall take on Lu Bu first.
This looks grim. Must I enter the battle myself...?
Hmm!? Yuan Shao is going out?
If our army cannot make its name here,
what is the point of all this?
Should I persuade Yuan Shao to stay where he is?
Fight alongside Yuan Shao
Keep Yuan Shao back
(No choice.
If we lose, it will all be over.)
Yuan Shao, support us from the rear.
Very well. Focus on the enemy before you.
I will deal with any who get through.
General Yuan, you must not go yourself!
The commander should direct the whole army.
Quite right. I leave this to you, then.
Make it a fine victory!
All troops, charge! Let none escape!
It is time for me to attack.
Who in the coalition dares face me?
To cross weapons with me
will be the greatest honor of your lives!
Can you hear me, Dong Zhuo?
You cannot even lead an army,
yet call yourself Chancellor. How laughable!
Come out! Stop hiding in your shell!
Damn you, Cao Cao! I will crush you myself
and put an end to your insolence!
No, my lord! A man of your stature
need not dirty his hands with rebels.
True. Order the troops to bring me his head!
As you command.
The time has come. We attack as well.
Tao Qian
Let us advance too.
We cannot fall behind the young men.
The enemy approaches. Watch how a commander fights!
Go! Intercept that unit!
You are Lu Fengxian? I will face you.
Hmph. You seem to have some skill.
Very well. Let me teach you a lesson!
I am Guan Yunchang, Liu Bei's sworn brother. Lu Bu,
they say your skill is unmatched.
I have come to test it.
Interesting. I will not hold back. Come on!
Brave indeed! But can you withstand this? Take that!
Hyaaah!
Hah!
What! Now this is interesting!
Such a worthy warrior! What a pleasure!
(He truly is formidable.
Lu Fengxian fights like a god or demon.)
I am Zhang Fei, courtesy name Yide! Lu Bu!
Fight me to the death!
Such spirit! Then let us fight!
Zhang Yide of Yan is here! Lu Bu,
from today I shall be the strongest under Heaven!
You will regret saying that so soon!
He... vanished!?
Hahaha! Too slow! Too slow!
Ugh! You! Stand still if you dare!
What!? Gone again? Impossible!
Quite possible. Now die!
Uooooh!
Now I am angry!
Truly angry!
(Ugh, such strength!
My arm is numb!)
What is wrong, Lu Bu? This fight is not over!
I have no time for this!
I will play with you no longer!
Do not worry. We will settle this another day!
You are nothing special. Your tongue fights better than you do.
What did you say!? Lu Bu!
Hey! Stop! Come back!
Damn that arrogant fool!
All talk, and now he runs!
You are a warrior renowned throughout the realm,
yet serve a man like Dong Zhuo.
Have you no shame?
As a warrior, I do not question my master.
I seek only a stage on which to fight!
That is the difference between us, Liu Bei.
...(A warrior is still a man,
but this one knows nothing of righteousness.)
Are you finished? Then let us settle this!
Lu Bu, with such ability,
why not do some good for the people?
Enough, Liu Bei!
A warrior proves his worth only in battle.
Then we have no choice but to fight!
Yes! Come on!
Damn it!
Hah... hah...
(Hmm! He is stronger than I expected!
I must not underestimate him.)
Come, Lu Bu! Let us exchange a few more blows!
Liu Bei, I have seen your skill.
We will finish this another time.
He relies on nothing but his own strength...
Damn... to think I could be defeated...
Retreat! Retreat!
What? Lu Bu has fled?
Is the coalition that strong!?
There is nothing else for it now.
We must hold Hulao Pass until they give up.
The enemy outside the walls is defeated!
The coalition overcame Dong Zhuo,
but he held fast inside Hulao Pass.
Unable to take the pass at once,
the coalition withdrew to prepare another assault.
Damn those coalition scum!
I will have revenge!
Withdraw! Withdraw!
This is hopeless. I must escape!
How... how could this be...?
Aaagh!
Is this the price of choosing the wrong master?
Ugh...
Damn it! Dong Zhuo was almost within reach!
I cannot die here. Retreat!
Just wait! I will avenge this one day!
Dong Zhuo was right before us... how bitter!
Retreat!
I cannot afford to die.
Regrettable, but I must return to the main camp.
Cao Cao, I leave the rest to you.
Hmm, what a pity...
Ten years younger, and I would not have lost!
The coalition defeated Dong Zhuo's army, but he held
Hulao Pass. Unable to take it at once,
they withdrew to prepare another assault.
Cao Cao was defeated by Dong Zhuo.
After him! Do not let Dong Zhuo escape!
Hmph. They never give up.
Li Ru, find a way to hold them off!
I have been eager to face them.
I shall defeat them without fail.
Good. I leave this to you.
Yes! Leave everything to me.
Proceed to Chang'an without concern, my lord.
Dong Zhuo escapes
1. Defeat Li Ru.
Defeat Li Ru!
Li Ru, shall we sortie?
The time is right. The Chancellor is far away now.
Let us strike before withdrawing.
This time I will take Cao Cao's head!
Li Ru, catch any stragglers here.
Leave it to me.
Good. Attack!
Our army has reached its limit!
Should we retreat...?
Retreat immediately
Continue the pursuit
All troops, withdraw at once! (So close...
We almost caught Dong Zhuo...
What a pity.)
1. Cao Cao reaches the west edge.
2. Defeat Li Ru.
Cao Cao must escape to the west edge!
Trying to run? Do not struggle in vain.
Generals, attack!
Now it is our turn to pursue.
Cao Cao, I will not let you escape!
How could we withdraw now?
We chose to pursue him. We must see it through.
But something is strange...
Why are there so few enemy troops?
Hahaha! Cao Cao is still a novice.
Before my schemes, he is as witless as a pig.
Generals, put in a little effort.
The quickest of you will claim his head!
Today's divination foretold good fortune in the woods.
It seems it was right! Hahaha!
Cao Cao, let my blade tell your fortune!
All troops, advance!
Xu Rong
Hmph. Li Ru's plan is sound,
but I have no wish to keep hiding.
Let me cut them down!
Cao Cao, never advance deep without support.
Greed for glory never ends well.
Now where will you run?
Oh no!
We have fallen into an ambush!
Now they have us from both sides!
All troops, retreat at once! (So close...
Even retreat will be difficult now.
Our only choice is to strike Li Ru.
Damn it! We cannot avoid them!
All troops, charge!
Well done, Cao Cao. You saw through my plan.
Then I must fight you with all I have.
Curse that Xu Rong. His luck is truly terrible.
Very well. Advance and pursue Cao Cao!
Impressive! You discovered my ambush.
But you will not leave until you defeat me!
An ambush, just as I feared!
This will be a difficult battle...
What? We were discovered...?
The divination was wrong again!
Very well. All troops, attack!
Well done, Cao Cao. You saw through my plan.
Good! At last we can attack!
I will cut them all down! Charge!
Cao Cao, today you die!
We will join the attack and crush Cao Cao!
Attack!
Hah... we finally escaped.
Li Ru, prepare yourself!
To fight your way here is impressive indeed.
But we have already won this battle.
You will never catch Chancellor Dong Zhuo now.
I shall go to Chang'an as well.
Cao Cao! We shall meet again!
Oh no... ugh!
That hurts! Damn it, retreat!
Next time I will consult a diviner before fighting!
Impressive! But the Chancellor is far away now.
You can no longer catch him.
I should not linger here either.
What a shame, Cao Cao. I shall take my leave!
Cao Cao defeated Dong Zhuo!
But Cao Cao's army also suffered heavy losses
and had to abandon the pursuit.
Excellent! The enemy is defeated at last!
Victory belongs to our army!
